summary.en: Kogoro Mouri had previously received a request from a woman named Satsuki Makabe about an ill speaking note, so he is now observing the man who could have done it. After he gets out of the elevator, Kogoro enters the elevator and sees a similar one, so he assumes that man was the culprit, but Kogoro has to take him back to the Detective Agency when he doesn’t admit his wrongdoing. There, Satsuki reveals that he is her younger brother named Yuto Makabe. Yuto blames his sister for not lending him money when he was in financial trouble, which angers Satsuki and she slaps him. Kogoro initially plans to take him to the police station, but Satsuki decides to make Yuto sign a contract not to bother her again, although after he leaves, she tears up the contract, thinking that it might continue. A few days later, the police receive a case where a notorious and debauched man who lived off his family's vast fortune named Ryoichi Doba is found dead in his apartment. Soon after, Megure finishes a call from an anonymous person saying that a woman had talked to the victim about her grudge against him, Takagi and Chiba inform Megure that they have found 10 people who have grudges against the victim, with one of them being Satsuki Makabe. Location: Doba's apartment, Rinkai Town, Tokyo Victim: Ryoichi Doba Cause of death: Stab wound to the back Suspects: Satsuki Makabe and Yuto Makabe The next day, while interrogating Satsuki, Megure mentions the accident caused by Doba led to the death of Satsuki's fiancé Kensuke Tateishi as the reason why she is one of the suspects. She claims that she was in Ochibadai at the time of the murder and Yuto can confirm this because they met at Ochibadai Station, however, her younger brother confirms that he never went to Ochibadai and that he was home that day. So she turns to Kogoro again, this time it seems to the two, and Conan (and some of us) that Yuto is lying and they need to find a way to get him to tell the truth. Victim: Kensuke Tateishi Cause of death: Car accident Culprit: Ryoichi Doba However, the investigation goes nowhere because just considering Yuto and Satsuki, there are so many possible situations revolving around alibis, contradictions and the possible culprit that even Conan has difficulty in deducing. Suddenly an idea flashes, the boy asks Yuto for the phone number of the people who had asked him for debt to confirm something. Then the boy calls everyone and starts his deduction performance through the Sleeping Kogoro.
